digest.component_or_area: outbound reconciliation dispatch and cross-project validation
propositions: Outbound create mutations currently fail closed when targeting projects outside a single configured project, requiring multi-project routing to resolve the target project per ticket at mutation-build time and stamp it into the create payload.

The cross-project guard currently enforces strict equality against one configured project string but must relax to set membership to allow legitimate writes to all projects in the store mapping while still rejecting unsynced projects.

Both Cloud and Data Center transport implementations must read a resolved project target from the create payload, with Data Center additionally filtering the reserved key from the Jira field set to prevent HTTP 400 errors.
A ticket with a bridge_project binding to a project absent from the store mapping must emit no create mutation to prevent writes to unsynced projects.
The guard's caller must supply the authoritative project set from the store mapping rather than a single configured project, with fallback to single-project behavior for unseeded stores.
